how_to_check: Lighthouse or Chrome DevTools Performance tab. Check largest contentful paint element.
fix_pattern: Preload hero image. Use srcset + WebP. Inline critical CSS. Remove render-blocking resources.

how_to_check: Lighthouse CLS score. Check for elements shifting after load.
fix_pattern: Set explicit width/height on images and embeds. Reserve space for async content. Use font-display:swap.

how_to_check: Chrome DevTools or web-vitals library. Measures interaction responsiveness.
fix_pattern: Avoid long tasks (>50ms). Break heavy JS into chunks. Use requestIdleCallback for non-urgent work.

how_to_check: npm run build then check dist/ output. Or use source-map-explorer.
fix_pattern: Code-split by route. Tree-shake unused code. Replace heavy libs (moment→dayjs). Lazy-load below-fold components.

threshold_good: WebP or AVIF with lazy-load and srcset
how_to_check: Check Network tab for image sizes. Audit with Lighthouse.
fix_pattern: Convert to WebP/AVIF. Add loading=lazy to below-fold images. Use srcset for responsive sizes. Compress to <100KB.

threshold_poor: No swap + no preload + 4+ font weights
how_to_check: Check Google Fonts URL for display=swap. Count font files in Network tab.
fix_pattern: Add display=swap to @font-face. Preload critical fonts. Limit to 2 weights per family. Use system-ui fallback.

threshold_poor: CSS/JS in head without async or defer
how_to_check: Lighthouse 'Eliminate render-blocking resources'. Check head tag.
fix_pattern: Inline critical CSS (<14KB). async/defer on scripts. Preload critical resources. Move non-critical CSS to footer.

how_to_check: Chrome DevTools Network waterfall view. Look for long sequential chains.
fix_pattern: Use Promise.all() for independent fetches. Preload/prefetch known resources. Reduce redirect chains.

threshold_good: Explicit dimensions on all media and embeds
threshold_poor: No width/height on images or iframes causing reflow
how_to_check: Check for images without width/height attributes. Test with slow 3G throttle.
fix_pattern: Always set width + height on img/video/iframe. Use aspect-ratio CSS. Reserve skeleton space for async content.

threshold_poor: Barrel file re-exports importing entire packages
how_to_check: Check for index.ts barrel files. Use source-map-explorer to find unused code.
fix_pattern: Import from specific module paths: import { Button } from './Button' not from './components'.

threshold_good: Route-based lazy loading + dynamic imports for heavy components
how_to_check: Check if React.lazy/Suspense or dynamic import() used for routes.
fix_pattern: Wrap routes in React.lazy(). Use dynamic import() for modals/charts/heavy features. Vite handles chunking automatically.

threshold_good: Hashed filenames with immutable Cache-Control headers
threshold_poor: No-cache on static assets or no content hashing
how_to_check: Check response headers for Cache-Control. Verify filenames include hash.
fix_pattern: Configure build tool for content-hashed filenames. Set Cache-Control: public max-age=31536000 immutable on static assets.
